mapper.sql: select ctrf_llave as key ,ctrf_nombre as nombre ,ctrf_tiporecurso as tipoRecurso ,ctrf_tiporecursonombre as tipoRecursoNombre ,ctrf_tipodimension2 as tipoDimension2 ,ctrf_tipodimension2nombre as tipoDimension2Nombre ,ctrf_tipodimension3 as tipoDimension3 ,ctrf_tipodimension3nombre as tipoDimension3Nombre ,ctrf_tipodimension4 as tipoDimension4 ,ctrf_tipodimension4nombre as tipoDimension4Nombre ,btrf_productoopcional as productoOpcional ,btrf_rangovalores as rangoValores ,btrf_rangocantidad as rangoCantidad ,dtrf_fechainicial as fechaInicial ,dtrf_fechafinal as fechaFinal ,ctrf_documento as documento ,dtrf_creacionfecha as createdAt ,ctrf_creacionusuario as createdUser ,ctrf_creacionusuarionombre as createdUserName ,dtrf_modificacionfecha as updatedAt ,ctrf_estado as state from tarifario_trfp a
